en.title: ShareFile Gains Accessible Collaboration Tools Amid Disability Tech Advances
en.summary: Applause and Progress Software have launched accessibility features for ShareFile, enabling accessible collaboration for users with disabilities worldwide. Meanwhile, Rockaway Beach, Oregon became the first U.S. community to finish a destination-wide accessibility audit for short-term rentals, and Penn researchers secured a Google grant to enhance medical imaging accessibility. Additional coverage includes an autism hub turning research into real‑world support and a wheelchair dancer’s experience with the Royal Ballet.

highlights.title: Applause and Progress Software Enable Accessible Collaboration for ShareFile Users Worldwide
Rockaway Beach, Oregon becomes first U.S. community to complete destination-wide accessibility audit for short-term rentals
Penn researchers awarded Google grant to improve medical imaging accessibility
Autism hub turns research into real-world support
'Like swimming through the air': my thrilling role in Giselle with the Royal Ballet School’s wheelchair dancers

zh-TW.title: ShareFile 加入無障礙協作功能，殘障科技進展多元
zh-TW.summary: Applause 與 Progress Software 為 ShareFile 推出無障礙協作功能，讓全球殘障使用者能夠無障礙協作。岩瓦海灘完成美國首個短租目的地全域無障礙審計，賓夕法尼亞大學獲 Google 贊助金改善醫學影像無障礙。此外，自閉症知識中心將研究轉化為實際支援，以及一位輪椅舞者分享在皇家芭蕾學校的體驗。

俄勒冈州岩瓦海滩成为美国首个完成短租目的地范围无障碍审计的社区
賓夕法尼亞大學研究員獲得 Google 贊助金以改善醫學影像無障礙
自閉症知識中心將研究轉化為實際支援
「如在空中游泳」：我在皇家芭蕾學校輪椅舞者中的吉賽爾體驗
